description:
Rolls every not-yet-blocked Witness Event for an AIT into one signed
ATAP Attestation Block with a profile `period_summary`, chained onto the
prior block.

**Holder authentication (2026-10-16).** Writes to an AIT's chain require
`Authorization: Bearer <holder_secret>`, the secret `sigil_atap_register_ait`
returns once. 401 without it, 403 if it does not match. AITs registered
before holder authentication have no secret and are frozen for writes
(403): register a new AIT to continue.
name: sigil_atap_roll_block
